entities.summary: ALLPlayer is a cross-platform media player and streaming media server written by ALLPlayer Group Ltd. ALLPlayer is available for desktop Windows and mobile platforms, such as Android, iPad and iPhone iOS. The program is available on App Store, Google Play Store and the Microsoft Windows Store.
